subject.title: [Bug]: openai-responses sends role="system" instead of role="developer" for reasoning models

question: Should non-native `openai-responses` reasoning models default to `developer` role, or should relays like new-api use an explicit `compat.supportsDeveloperRole: true` opt-in?
rationale: The source-visible bug is real for this relay, but the default is compatibility-sensitive because other OpenAI-compatible providers can reject developer-role messages.

options.title: Keep default, document opt-in
options.body: Preserve the conservative proxy default and add docs/tests showing `compat.supportsDeveloperRole: true` for Responses relays that require developer-role system prompts.

options.title: Change Responses default
options.body: Default non-native `openai-responses` reasoning models to `developer` and require explicit opt-out for relays that reject that role.

options.title: Treat as support workaround
options.body: Close or defer the issue as already configurable, accepting that the current docs do not make the Responses opt-in obvious.

recommendation.title: Keep default, document opt-in
recommendation.body: Preserve the conservative proxy default and add docs/tests showing `compat.supportsDeveloperRole: true` for Responses relays that require developer-role system prompts.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent AI runtime/package and provider-compatibility history makes this the best available owner for the default-policy decision.
